text: 中国工商银行、中国农业银行、中国银行、中国建设银行发布风险提示，提醒金融消费者警惕“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”“固定年化收益5%”等虚假信息。四家银行表示，近期，有不法分子利用第三方互联网平台及社交媒体等渠道，冒用国有商业银行名义，发布“存100万元解锁5.25%利息”“固定年化收益5%”等虚假高息收益广告，并且以此诱导消费者添加微信等联系方式，进而推介境外保险产品或者投资境外平台项目等，牟取高额佣金甚至实施诈骗。经核实，当前不存在此类存款产品，相关宣传均为虚假信息。（广州日报）
text_en: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, and China Construction Bank have issued risk warnings, alerting financial consumers to be cautious of false information such as 'deposit 1 million yuan to unlock a 5.25% interest rate' and 'fixed annualized return of 5%.' The four banks stated that recently, criminals have been using third-party internet platforms and social media channels to impersonate state-owned commercial banks, posting false high-yield advertisements like 'deposit 1 million yuan to unlock a 5.25% interest rate' and 'fixed annualized return of 5%.' This lures consumers into adding WeChat or other contact methods, to then recommend overseas insurance products or invest in offshore platform projects, seeking high commissions or even committing fraud. After verification, such deposit products do not currently exist, and all related promotions are false information. (Guangzhou Daily)
